Datara Table Lamp With Wireless Charger – Modern Floating Lamp with Smart Touch Control

Upgrade your workspace or bedroom with the Datara Table Lamp With Wireless Charger, a perfect blend of modern design, smart lighting, and fast charging convenience. Designed for today’s lifestyle, this innovative floating lamp features touch control operation, adjustable brightness, and a built-in fast wireless charging pad, making it both functional and visually striking. Whether placed on a bedside table, office desk, or living room console, this premium lamp enhances your décor while reducing clutter.

The elegant floating lamp design creates a futuristic appeal, while the premium wood base adds warmth and durability. With 3 colour modes and smooth brightness control, this lamp adapts effortlessly to reading, working, relaxing, or ambient lighting needs. The integrated fast wireless charging pad supports Qi-enabled smartphones, allowing you to charge your device cable-free while enjoying optimal illumination.

Key Features of Datara Table Lamp With Wireless Charger

  • Stylish floating lamp design for a modern and premium look
  • Smart touch control lamp with easy on/off and mode switching
  • 3 colour mode table lamp – warm, neutral, and cool light options
  • Custom brightness control for eye comfort and productivity
  • Built-in fast wireless charging pad for Qi-enabled devices
  • Elegant and durable premium wood base lamp
  • Energy-efficient LED lighting with long lifespan

Smart Lighting Meets Wireless Charging

The Datara Table Lamp With Wireless Charger is designed to simplify your daily routine. Its fast wireless charging pad eliminates tangled cables and keeps your desk neat and organized. Simply place your compatible smartphone on the charging base and enjoy seamless charging while you work, read, or relax. This makes it an ideal wireless charging table lamp for home offices, study rooms, and bedside use.

The advanced touch control system allows you to adjust brightness levels smoothly with a simple tap. Switch between the three colour modes to suit different moods or tasks—warm light for relaxation, neutral light for everyday use, and cool light for focused work. This touch control LED lamp is engineered for comfort and convenience.

Premium Design with Functional Elegance

Crafted with a premium wood base, this modern table lamp offers a perfect balance between contemporary technology and natural aesthetics. The floating lamp effect creates a visually captivating centerpiece, making it a popular choice among customers searching for a designer table lamp with wireless charging. Its compact yet impactful design fits effortlessly into both minimalist and luxury interiors.

The sturdy base ensures stability, while the LED lighting technology provides consistent brightness without flicker. This makes it a reliable brightness control lamp for extended usage, whether for late-night reading or long work sessions.

Ideal for Home, Office, and Gifting

The is not just a lighting accessory—it’s a smart lifestyle upgrade. It is ideal for bedrooms, offices, study desks, hotels, and modern living spaces. With its premium finish and multifunctional design, it also makes an excellent corporate gift, festive gift, or premium home décor gift.

If you are looking for a floating lamp with touch control, a wireless charging bedside lamp, or a modern LED table lamp with wood base, this product delivers exceptional value, style, and performance.

Why Choose Datara?

  • Modern, clutter-free lighting and charging solution
  • Optimized for comfort with adjustable brightness and colour modes
  • Durable materials with premium aesthetics
  • Compatible with most Qi-enabled smartphones
  • Designed to complement contemporary interiors
